title: biophys_interop: an open standardization and model-free QC layer for biophysical bioactivity data
description: biophys_interop is a dependency-light Python toolkit for standardizing heterogeneous biophysical bioactivity measurements and applying transparent, method-aware quality-control rules. This software release contains the canonical schema, 72-rule QC registry, command-line interface, examples, and a runnable quickstart notebook. The full reproducibility dataset is archived separately because its ChEMBL-derived records are licensed CC BY-SA 3.0.
